query: Audit the skills in this repo against the skill best practices and tell me what to improve.
files: A repository with skills/ holding two skills: one whose reference file links on to a second reference and whose description has no when-to-use clause, and one that links to the other skill's SKILL.md by a relative path.
expected_behavior: Reads the repository's README and AGENTS.md before judging, and changes no files
Runs scripts/check_guide.py first and says whether the checklist is up to date
Runs scripts/check_skills.py on the repository root and uses its findings as evidence
Reports the chained reference, the missing when-to-use clause, and the link into the other skill's folder, each with file:line evidence and a concrete fix
Drafts three evals for each skill, including one near-miss request
Shows the full report in the final message, ranks the fixes, and asks which to make

query: Is the description of my committing skill good enough for Claude to pick it up?
expected_behavior: Limits the audit to the committing skill and to the description points (frontmatter, naming, triggering)
Checks the frontmatter limits and whether the description says both what the skill does and when to use it
Suggests the words a user would type that the description is missing, as a rewritten description
Does not edit the file until the user picks a fix

query: Write a new skill that deploys this app to Fly.io.
expected_behavior: Does not load auditing-skills, because the request is to create a skill, not to audit one
Writes the new skill instead of producing an audit report
